Declare the minimal local auxiliary chi,chi_plus field/ghost/antifield representation and the complete support-local action ansatz capable of contributing at that witness. Derive q1, q2 and q3 from one extended action, close the full Diff, Weyl, Maxwell and Berger-U(1) representation orbit, and replay nilpotency, odd cyclicity, the arity-two and arity-three master identities, K_Berger compatibility and the obstructing source mutation. Either construct a nonempty admissible completion family and classify its moduli, or prove that every member of the complete declared auxiliary orbit retains an exact obstruction and identify the next missing representation. Only after the full action gates pass may the item replay rods, clocks, emitters, receivers or detector response. Land exact certificates, an independent verifier, coefficient and representation-removal mutations, an atlas update and a Paper 09 lifecycle disposition.
